messages.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

### Short answer [20][23][25]
【Inference】When automotive radar uses 76 GHz to 81 GHz operation, GHz-class instantaneous bandwidth, FMCW/digital echo generation, artificial objects, ghost-object checks and Doppler behavior, the VNA needs mmWave-capable frequency coverage, wide-span IF/RF characterization, time-domain analysis, fine frequency stepping, controlled measurement bandwidth, and high dynamic range/low-noise transmission measurement capability [20][23][25][2][3][19].
### Evidence from the automotive radar side [20][23][25]
Automotive radar configurations in the passages cover 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 76 GHz to 81 GHz RF bands [25].  
The AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth is 1 GHz, 2 GHz or 5 GHz depending on option, and its IF frequency ranges include 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz and 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz as listed in the source summary [25].  
The R&S QAT100 with AREG800A covers 76 GHz to 77 GHz and 77 GHz to 81 GHz, has 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth, and requires 1 GHz instantaneous bandwidth at AREG800A because of a 4× multiplication concept [23].  
The AREG800A echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation, and its digital concept is for FMCW radar with generated distances up to 3000 m [20].  
Each artificial object supports individual Doppler frequency shift, with velocity setting range ±500 km/h and velocity step size 0.001 km/h for R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-B63 [19].  
### VNA capability implied by the stated automotive radar measurements [2][3][7][15][36][44]
The AREG800A ghost-object suppression measurement explicitly uses a vector network analyzer in time domain with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [2].  
The AREG800A dynamic RCS and IF transfer measurements list vector network analyzer conditions of 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [3].  
The R&S ZNA series covers 10 MHz to 67 GHz, while the R&S ZNA67EXT vector network analyzer system covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz [9][44].  
The R&S ZNA67 provides 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace and measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz, or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [15].  
The R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range greater than 129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [7].  
The R&S ZNA software options include time domain analysis, extended time domain analysis, increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz and group delay measurements [36].  
【Inference】The move to 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar frontends makes VNA frequency coverage or mmWave extension important because base R&S ZNA reaches 67 GHz while R&S ZNA67EXT reaches 110 GHz [25][9][44].  
【Inference】The move to GHz-class radar bandwidth makes VNA sweep span, frequency-step control and measurement-bandwidth control important because the radar test conditions require spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz, 125 kHz or 2.5 MHz frequency steps and 100 kHz or 1 kHz measurement bandwidth [25][2][3].  
【Inference】The move to artificial-object, ghost-object and Doppler-oriented radar testing makes VNA time-domain and high-dynamic-range transmission characterization important because ghost suppression is measured by VNA in time domain, dynamic RCS ranges reach 90 dB or 60 dB depending on object configuration, and ZNA dynamic range can exceed 129 dB [2][3][7].

[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]介紹電信技術中心毫米波頻段測試量能：

- 5G FR2 毫米波天線縮距量測場 CATR。
- 來源稱該 chamber 依據 3GPP 技術規範標準，已通過 TAF 認證。
- 支援主波發射頻段 3–40 GHz。
- 不必要發射可至 90 GHz。
- 可量測 TRP、TIS、EVM。
- Quiet Zone 可達 90 cm。

R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 與既有 NGeCall / hybrid eCall 頁面的關係
- [[NGeCall over LTE]] 整理 CMW500 與 CMX500 capability lists，本頁只整理 PR 中的 Qualcomm / Snapdragon verification event。
- [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 整理 configuration guide 的 mandatory / optional items，本頁不取代正式 configuration 或 quote。
- [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 以 EN 18052:2025 與 hybrid fallback 為核心；本頁聚焦 EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification，不描述 classic CS fallback 或 EN 18052 test scope。
- [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 提到 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 與 cetecom advanced certification testing；本頁來源只提 EN 17240:2024，且未說第三方 certification report。

欣銓 › 來源中的說法
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC]] 在功率半導體封測區塊將 [[欣銓]] 寫為「車用與功率IC測試核心廠」。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S ZNB3020
[[R&S ZNB3020]] 是 [[R&S ZNB3000]] 系列的 20 GHz Vector Network Analyzer 型號，依 Version 09.00（July 2026）base frequency range 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 frequency upgrade option 可到 26.5 GHz。

R&S ZNA26 › Software options
[[R&S ZNA26]] 可使用 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列 software / measurement options，例如 [[R&S ZNA-K1]] spectrum analyzer mode、[[R&S ZNA-K6]] phase coherent source control、[[R&S ZNA-K7]] measurements on pulsed signals、[[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support、[[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements、[[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement、[[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS。各 option 的 order no. 與相依關係見 [[R&S ZNA]]。

R&S CMPHEAD30 › mmWave RF generator
| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| 搭配 | [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CM-Z30A]] |
| Duplex mode | half duplex（TDD） |
| Frequency range | 28 GHz band：24.25 GHz to 31.80 GHz；39 GHz band：37.00 GHz to 43.50 GHz |
| Frequency resolution | < 0.1 Hz |
| Maximum reverse power | 0 V DC，+25 dBm |
| Output level range | 28 GHz band PEP –84 dBm to +20 dBm；37 GHz ≤ f ≤ 40 GHz PEP –78 dBm to +19 dBm；40 GHz < f ≤ 43.5 GHz PEP –78 dBm to +17 dBm |
| Output level uncertainty | 28 GHz band，–50 dBm to +15 dBm CW：< 2.5 dB；39 GHz band，–45 dBm to +10 dBm CW：< 3.0 dB |
| Output level repeatability | 1 h warm-up 後 typ. < 0.2 dB |
| Isolation of RF ports | RF 1 to RF 2 > 27 dB，35 dB typ. |

EVM 條件：SCS 60 kHz / 120 kHz、64QAM、+15 °C to +35 °C、within ±5 °C from last I/Q alignment。來源標示 EVM 為 measured values。

朋程 › 限制與不可推論事項
- 「全球第一」是圖上用語；來源未提供排名口徑、市占率、年度、產品範圍或資料來源拆分。
- 來源未標示日期，因此不能把上述列名寫成特定時間點的市場現況。
- 來源是概念股整理表，不構成投資建議或供應鏈驗證。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單
[[無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單]]原本由 [[Test House]] 提供待讀材料索引；[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]新增了[[電信技術中心]]在 111年08月簡報中的毫米波頻段測試量能描述；[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]則補入 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 的簡報正文摘要。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍

- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。

- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context
同一來源提供下列背景，但未列 regulation 文件編號：

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

NTN 頻譜與頻段 › Upper C-band 與未來高頻 bands
Rel. 20 proposal 處理 upper C-band for NTN usage：

- Upper C-band：3800–4200 MHz。
- 建議作為 supplementary downlink channel for NTN。
- 因 terrestrial coexistence concerns，來源說建議 C-band frequencies 僅用於 downlink direction。

未來 NTN enhancements 也討論更高頻 bands：

- Q/V bands：37–44 GHz and 47–52 GHz。
- E-band：71–76 GHz and 81–86 GHz。
- Satellite D-band：110–170 GHz。
- Free space optics：例如 ISL 或 optical feeder link。

來源判斷這些高頻率會先用於 satellite 與 terrestrial gateway 間的 feeder link，長期可能也用於 service link。

NGSO FSS 系統 › TeraWave 案例
[[BlueOriginTerawave]]（來源未標示正式日期；raw converted 2026-09-17）與 [[Terawave-Tech]]（來源未標示正式日期；raw converted 2026-09-18）皆稱 [[TeraWave]] 是 proposed NGSO FSS system，使用 Q/V-band、E-band、S-band 與 Ka-band，並處理與 terrestrial fixed services、GSO systems、other NGSO FSS operations、Radio Astronomy Service 與 EESS passive 的相容性。

TeraWave 的 NGSO FSS system composition：

- Space segment：5,408 satellites，包含 5,280 顆 LEO satellites 與 128 顆 MEO satellites。
- Ground segment：Operations Centers、gateway Earth stations、user terminals、optical ground terminals。
- User links：Q/V-band 37.5–42.0 GHz downlink；47.2–50.2 GHz 與 50.4–51.4 GHz uplink。
- Gateway links：E-band 71–76 GHz downlink；81–86 GHz uplink。
- TT&C：LEO primary E-band、LEO contingency / LEOP Ka-band；MEO primary Ka-band、MEO contingency / LEOP S-band。
- Antenna / beam approach：user terminals and user beams use phased array antennas；gateway links use steerable parabolic antennas；TT&C uses omnidirectional antennas。

[[Terawave-Tech]] 與 [[BlueOriginTerawave]] 高度重複，故上述 TeraWave 案例仍應視為同一 filing technical annex 的資料，不可視為兩份獨立市場驗證。

### Short answer [20][23][25]
【Inference】When automotive radar uses 76 GHz to 81 GHz operation, GHz-class instantaneous bandwidth, FMCW/digital echo generation, artificial objects, ghost-object checks and Doppler behavior, the VNA needs mmWave-capable frequency coverage, wide-span IF/RF characterization, time-domain analysis, fine frequency stepping, controlled measurement bandwidth, and high dynamic range/low-noise transmission measurement capability [20][23][25][2][3][19].
### Evidence from the automotive radar side [20][23][25]
Automotive radar configurations in the passages cover 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 76 GHz to 81 GHz RF bands [25].  
The AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth is 1 GHz, 2 GHz or 5 GHz depending on option, and its IF frequency ranges include 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz and 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz as listed in the source summary [25].  
The R&S QAT100 with AREG800A covers 76 GHz to 77 GHz and 77 GHz to 81 GHz, has 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth, and requires 1 GHz instantaneous bandwidth at AREG800A because of a 4× multiplication concept [23].  
The AREG800A echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation, and its digital concept is for FMCW radar with generated distances up to 3000 m [20].  
Each artificial object supports individual Doppler frequency shift, with velocity setting range ±500 km/h and velocity step size 0.001 km/h for R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-B63 [19].  
### VNA capability implied by the stated automotive radar measurements [2][3][7][15][36][44]
The AREG800A ghost-object suppression measurement explicitly uses a vector network analyzer in time domain with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [2].  
The AREG800A dynamic RCS and IF transfer measurements list vector network analyzer conditions of 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [3].  
The R&S ZNA series covers 10 MHz to 67 GHz, while the R&S ZNA67EXT vector network analyzer system covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz [9][44].  
The R&S ZNA67 provides 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace and measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz, or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [15].  
The R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range greater than 129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [7].  
The R&S ZNA software options include time domain analysis, extended time domain analysis, increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz and group delay measurements [36].  
【Inference】The move to 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar frontends makes VNA frequency coverage or mmWave extension important because base R&S ZNA reaches 67 GHz while R&S ZNA67EXT reaches 110 GHz [25][9][44].  
【Inference】The move to GHz-class radar bandwidth makes VNA sweep span, frequency-step control and measurement-bandwidth control important because the radar test conditions require spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz, 125 kHz or 2.5 MHz frequency steps and 100 kHz or 1 kHz measurement bandwidth [25][2][3].  
【Inference】The move to artificial-object, ghost-object and Doppler-oriented radar testing makes VNA time-domain and high-dynamic-range transmission characterization important because ghost suppression is measured by VNA in time domain, dynamic RCS ranges reach 90 dB or 60 dB depending on object configuration, and ZNA dynamic range can exceed 129 dB [2][3][7].
